facts.title: Nexus UI Labs — Animated React Components & Templates
facts.description: Free animated React components and Next.js templates built with Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion. Copy-paste, or install with the shadcn CLI.

research.name: Nexus UI
research.note: Animated React components, blocks and templates on Tailwind and Motion, with interface sounds and physics-driven interactions.

effects: Glass Bubbles: glass orbs hanging on threads that swing, collide and spin their icons when the pointer sweeps through
Draggable stickers thrown around the hero section
Interface sounds generated in code for many components

unverified: No dated product change was found: there is no changelog page, components are marked New without dates, and the dated blog posts (newest October 20, 2026) are guides rather than release notes.
The Glass Bubbles motion and the thrown stickers were seen only in static screenshots and descriptions, not in motion.
